{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693631919,"sessionID":"ses_e23eeba20ffeae2MHeFNwkRvbS","part":{"id":"prt_1dc138c24001SddW3kCM4x56oO","messageID":"msg_1dc136846001JZw1ABWe7vNj19","sessionID":"ses_e23eeba20ffeae2MHeFNwkRvbS","type":"text","text":"All four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 66 to the end of the shift. One action was a mistake: reverting a wishlist-svc config change that wasn't the cause, which probably cost a $10,000 wasted-mitigation charge.\n\n| Fault | What caused it | Fix |\n|---|---|---|\n| **couriers-svc retry storm** (mobile-api ~85% errors, present at the page) | Its traffic went from ~240 to ~630 requests/sec, more than 3 replicas can handle. The callers' retries then kept it overloaded. No recent change explains it. | Throttled it to clear the retries, then scaled it from 3 to 8 replicas. It runs at about 75% load and stays clean. |\n| **sitemap-svc retry storm** (partner-api ~78% errors, present at the page) | Config change cfg-48 removed `currency` from `price_fields`. | Throttled it and reverted cfg-48, then lifted the throttle. |\n| **promo-cache** (4% errors on admin-portal, web-storefront and partner-api, since minute -40) | Deploy v74 fixed the database connection pool at 4 connections, so requests timed out waiting for one. | Scaled from 4 to 6 replicas first because it was near capacity, then rolled back v74. Scaled back to 4 afterwards, which costs nothing. |\n| **profile-db**, a new fault at minute 45 (mobile-api errors returned) | Config change cfg-32 dropped `orders.write` from `token_scope`, causing PermissionDenied errors and another retry storm. | Throttled it, reverted cfg-32, then lifted the throttle. |\n\n**What it cost:**\n- **wishlist-svc revert:** I reverted its connection-pool config change (cfg-26) because the errors started around the same time. The real cause turned out to be the promo-cache deploy, so this revert probably counts as a $10,000 wasted mitigation.\n- **promo-cache rollback:** the rollback itself failed 30% of requests, and retries overloaded promo-cache briefly even after the scale-up. admin-portal saw about 33% errors for a few minutes around minute 50–55, a short but expensive window given its $15,600/min revenue.\n- **Extra couriers-svc replicas:** I left the 5 extra replicas running to the end, about $3/min ($1,400 for the shift). Without them it would overload again.\n\nNo throttles were left on, and the shift ran out the full 120 minutes with no further faults.","time":{"start":1794693631012,"end":1794693631917}}}
